name: Extract artifacts from data provided by a service provider
description: Parse data supplied by an online service provider into artifacts such as messages, accounts, contacts and events.
details: Covers data supplied to law enforcement in response to legal process (see DFT-1024) and data supplied by the provider to the account holder, e.g. Google Takeout or Meta 'Download Your Information'. Formats and field meanings differ between providers and change over time.
